name: full
description: Everything standard removes, plus every field that describes what was scanned: protocol name, series/study description, image comments, procedure IDs, and device identity. Not the preferred level: a full-policy archive is untraceable, but a clinician can no longer tell which folder holds which scan without opening the images. Matches the scanner's 'reduced' export.
